entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Parameter Count Mismatch: when using a Delegate during an async / await call via a lambda expression #117867
  • Redundant TEST instruction after ADD #117866
  • C# hostpolicy.dll Fatal Error #117863

Closed

  • [Android AOT] Precompiling failing in .NET 9 #113672
  • [6.0] Test failure in System.Formats.Asn1 ReadVeryLongOid_WithAppContext: could not load file or assembly in NET48 #104647
    10.0.0
  • `System.Numerics.Tensors.Tests.TensorSpanTests.TensorExtensionsTwoSpanInFloatOut` fails with `IndexOutOfRangeException` #107254
    10.0.0
  • [coreclr] `System.Numerics.Tensors.Tests` fails with `Index was outside the bounds of the array.` #107911
    10.0.0
  • Test failure: System.Numerics.Tensors.Tests.TensorSpanTests.TensorExtensionsSpanInTOut<Single> #107893
    10.0.0
  • Add ability to stream large strings in Utf8JsonWriter/Utf8JsonReader #67337
    10.0.0
  • [Mono]Assertion at /runtime/src/mono/mono/mini/mini-runtime.c:417, condition `ptr' not met #111012
  • possible null ref in SignatureHelper #110832
  • Access to NULL objects crashes the app even inside a try/catch block #110597
  • Android app doesn't build in Release mode (Mono Ahead of Time compiler) #107202
  • CookieContainer.GetAllCookies() randomly returns old cookie values #117860
  • Regex.Replace produces a wrong output when replacement ends with $' #117859
  • Tensor.Create overloads are extremely confusing and can lead to unintended behaviors #117244
    10.0.0
  • Tensor.Create Throws on strides #117855

PullRequests

Created

  • Delete AVX512 paths from `IndexOf(string)` #117865
    area-System.Memory, 10.0.0
  • Fix System.Object.GetCustomAttributes() returning extra internal attributes on Mono #117864
    area-System.Reflection, community-contribution
  • Delete ECHash #117861
    area-VM-coreclr
  • KeyGen and OSSL support for managed Composite ML-DSA + RSA #117856
    area-System.Security, 10.0.0

Merged

  • Delete AppDomain::m_Stage #117857
    area-VM-coreclr
  • adding GetAppDomainStoreData cDAC API #117633
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • Cleanup uses of Interlocked.CompareExchange<object> #117858
    area-System.Threading
  • Use C# 14's field keyword in more places #117817
    area-Meta
  • Couple of small cryptography refactorings #117850
    area-System.Security

Updated

  • Add XML documentation for 29 undocumented .NET 7.0 APIs #117697
  • Obsolete XsltSettings.EnableScript with SYSLIB0062 #117701
    area-System.Xml, breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created, 10.0.0
  • Adding GetMethodTableFieldData cDAC API #117684
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • adding GetOtherNotificationFlags cDAC API #117616
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • GetAppDomainList cDAC implementation #117515
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • Adding GetAppDomainData cDAC API #117827
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • New JsonValue derived class for JSON primitives #116798
    area-System.Text.Json, 10.0.0
  • System.Reflection.CustomAttributeFormatException thrown on a retrieval of derived attribute with overridden property getter #117584
    area-System.Reflection, linkable-framework, community-contribution
  • [cDAC] Implement IXCLRDataProcess.EnumMethodInstancesByAddress #115131
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • Inline CORINFO_HELP_ARRADDR_ST helper call, remove WriteBarrier FCall #117583
    area-VM-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #117845
    area-codeflow
  • Use HashSet/SearchValues when known OID list is long #117849
    area-System.Security
  • Remove ExperimentalAttribute from ML-KEM where applicable #117831
    area-System.Security, 10.0.0
